# `CheckCategory`

`Rasuvaeff\Yii3Mcp\Doctor\CheckCategory`

**Enum** — [`Rasuvaeff\Yii3Mcp`](/packages/core) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/yii3-mcp/blob/master/src/Doctor/CheckCategory.php)

Failure domain of a McpDoctor check — determines the command's exit
code, so scripts can tell a misconfiguration from a broken disk from an
unreachable upstream without parsing output.
